lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 to 6 vertical line segments of varying intensity; the central-most line is the highest contrast, with irregular spacing between fragmented anterior lines and more distinct posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments on the mid-flank are observed as abbreviated bars or high-contrast dots that terminate mid-torso without reaching the dorsal crest or ventral line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral, lyrate trajectory, projecting laterally from the base before curving inward and upward toward the apices.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips occupy approximately 10-15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest of elongated hair is visible along the spinal midline, and a distinct wide white vertical patch is present on the posterior-most aspect of the visible rump.
